summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Studio Inai app. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests passed (auth, public endpoints, content, services/team/projects CRUD, full booking flow incl. 409 conflict & 400 invalid weekday, contact messages, admin stats, availability). Frontend: All 23 home data-testids present; navigation to about/portfolio/schedule/contact pages works; portfolio filter (residential→4 cards, all→8) and modal open/close work; contact form submission shows contact-success and toast; schedule flow (cal-day pick → slot selection → form fill → sched-submit → schedule-success) creates a real booking visible in admin; admin login with admin@studioinai.com/StudioInai@2026 succeeds and redirects to /admin; admin-layout & admin-sidebar render; all 7 admin sections (dashboard, content, projects, team, services, messages, bookings, availability) load; content edit (hero_title) saves and reflects on public home; project create via admin UI appears on public portfolio; admin booking row click opens detail panel and status change persists.
critical_code_review_comments: Bookings admin uses auto-save via onChange (status) and onBlur (meeting_link/admin_notes) — there is no explicit booking-save button. The task description mentions clicking to save; current pattern works but consider adding an explicit Save action + success toast for clarity.
CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router — in FastAPI this still works because middleware is applied at app level, but conventional ordering is to add middleware before mounting routes.
seed.py uses ADMIN_PASSWORD default 'admin123' if env not set — fine since .env has StudioInai@2026, but worth flagging that production must always supply ADMIN_PASSWORD.
/api/availability/slots uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) for 'today' comparison — server UTC may not match user local timezone, could exclude/keep wrong slots near day boundaries.
Backend uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown — should migrate to lifespan handlers (warning visible at startup).
No rate limiting / brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails). Currently any number of attempts allowed.
test_credentials: admin@studioinai.com / StudioInai@2026 (verified, JWT Bearer flow works)
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data (4 team, 8 projects, 6 services). Created TEST_-prefixed bookings/messages/projects during testing and cleaned them up via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_studio_inai_api.py covers all critical flows and can be reused. Admin booking detail panel auto-saves: status on select change, meeting_link/admin_notes on blur — no explicit save button, no 'booking-save' testid (don't expect one). The schedule flow on public site requires picking a weekday (Mon-Fri have 5 slots, Sat 2, Sun 0) at least 1 day in future. Hero title is editable from /admin/content with data-testid='content-field-hero_title' + 'content-save'. CORS allows credentials; JWT tokens stored as localStorage 'inai_token'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — all reported features work as specified.
